Static review finds no blocking defect for the single described run. The test binds 8855 without listening, closes its sockets, performs no GPU/service operations, and rechecks the control contents.

Run exactly once with port 8855 and the new private paths. The parent runner must enforce the 30-second watchdog, capture the JSON stdout receipt, and clean up only its own child and test artifacts; those parent controls are not shown in these files. No approval is given for voice/director/ffmpeg/native changes, GPU tests, listeners, or further runs.
